exclusions.all_started_metric: None. Negative cases, extraction failures, operational failures and pending started episodes remain in the denominator; unknown monetary cost is not under budget.
exclusions.paired_contrast: Only B/F cells with both starts are paired. Pending starts score zero; unpaired cells are enumerated as excluded from contrast only.

limitations: Blind explanation scoring recognizes only pre-scored fixture texts; symbolic checking is a bounded registered integer-polynomial/solution-set checker.
Bootstrap resamples whole task families, retaining repetitions and paired conditions; CIs are exploratory, especially with few families.
